summary: A fund sells its most readily tradable holdings to pay investors leaving {fund}.
realLife: In the March briefing, money managers were selling short-dated securities they could readily trade to meet investor withdrawals.
gates: The record identifies the redemption requests and asset sales.
inGame: needs: redemption requests and asset sales.

turns.what: The portfolio has fewer easy-to-sell holdings left.
The manager can stop selling to meet them.
turns.writesBack: End date for sales attributed to withdrawals.
